how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-maraudon-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:7028:obj:0: Collect 15 Theradric Crystal Carvings for Willow in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:7028:details:0: The crystal caverns of Terramok lie to the west, deep within Maraudon... It is an ancient place with much history. And I am looking to get my hands on some of it, ⟦1⟧. Relics of the old gods lie hidden behind the giant doors.
rows.quest:7028:details:1: BIf you are willing to brave the twisted evils found in Maraudon, I believe I can make it worth your time. Collect the theradric crystal carvings you find, and return them to me.
rows.quest:7028:details:2: BOnce I get the carvings, I will be able to... study them. These powers have been too long at rest...
rows.quest:7028:completion:0: Ha ha ha! I knew you'd be back.
rows.quest:7028:completion:3: B...Will do anything for the right price. Heh heh heh...
rows.quest:7029:obj:0: Fill the Coated Cerulean Vial at the orange crystal pool in Maraudon.
rows.quest:7029:obj:1: BUse the Filled Cerulean Vial on the Vylestem Vines to force the corrupted Noxxious Scion to emerge.
rows.quest:7029:obj:2: BHeal 8 plants by killing these Noxxious Scion, then return to Vark Battlescar in Shadowprey Village.
rows.quest:7029:details:0: A satyr known as Vyletongue has corrupted the caverns of Maraudon, stunting the growth of many of the plants inside.
rows.quest:7029:details:1: BTake this vial, ⟦3⟧. Fill it at the orange crystal pool found inside the caverns; the coating inside the vial will counter the toxins, turning it into a healing agent.
rows.quest:7029:details:2: BFind the Vylestem vines inside the orange caverns, and use the purified liquid on them. The corruption will be purged from the plant, but do know that Vyletongue will still control it. He may use it against you...
rows.quest:7029:completion:0: Thank you for returning this, ⟦4⟧. With the remaining liquid you brought me, I can continue my studies.
rows.quest:7029:completion:1: BWhile there is still much to do, you have helped to heal some of the corruption that Vyletongue spread through Maraudon. Please take this with my gratitude.
rows.quest:7041:obj:0: Fill the Coated Cerulean Vial at the orange crystal pool in Maraudon.
rows.quest:7041:obj:1: BUse the Filled Cerulean Vial on the Vylestem Vines to force the corrupted Noxxious Scion to emerge.
rows.quest:7041:obj:2: BHeal 8 plants by killing these Noxxious Scion, then return to Talendria in Nijel's Point.
rows.quest:7041:details:0: A satyr known as Vyletongue has corrupted the caverns of Maraudon, stunting the growth of many of the plants inside.
rows.quest:7041:details:1: BTake this vial, ⟦5⟧. Fill it at the corrupted orange pool found inside the caverns; the coating inside the vial will counter the toxins, turning it into a healing agent.
rows.quest:7041:details:2: BFind the Vylestem vines inside the orange caverns, and use the purified liquid on them. The corruption will be purged from the plant, but do know that Vyletongue will still control it. He may use it against you...
rows.quest:7041:completion:0: Thank you for returning this, ⟦6⟧. With the remaining liquid you brought me, I can continue my studies.
rows.quest:7041:completion:1: BWhile there is still much to do, you have helped to heal some of the corruption that Vyletongue spread through Maraudon. Please take this with my gratitude.
rows.quest:7044:obj:0: Recover the two parts of the Scepter of ⟦E2⟧: the Celebrian Rod and the Celebrian Diamond.
rows.quest:7044:obj:1: BFind a way to speak with ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:7044:details:0: A dark satyr called Lord Vyletongue spread his evil through these twisting caves, poisoning the minds of all inside. He still resides beyond the purple crystals.
rows.quest:7044:details:1: BVyletongue also created a living symbol of his corruption called ⟦E3⟧ that dwells beyond the orange crystals. Together, they have stolen the two parts of my brother's scepter. ⟦E2⟧, my brother... he wanders blindly inside, cursed by corruption.
rows.quest:7044:details:2: BYou must help him! Find the pieces, and speak to my brother... somehow.
rows.quest:7044:completion:0: Now that you have recovered the two parts of my scepter, I have hope that Maraudon may one day be rid of the Vyle corruption.
rows.quest:7046:obj:0: Assist ⟦E2⟧ the Redeemed while he creates the Scepter of ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:7046:obj:1: BSpeak with him when the ritual is complete.
rows.quest:7046:details:0: My scepter was once a source of hope for me. Its power allowed me the freedom to travel quickly through these caverns. I had hoped to bring peace to the spirit of my uncle... It is a task that I now pass to you.
rows.quest:7046:details:1: BFor the two parts to once again become one, I will need your assistance in performing the ritual. Please follow me, and listen to my instructions while I channel the energy required to reunite the rod with the diamond.
rows.quest:7046:details:2: BTogether, we shall create the Scepter of ⟦E2⟧ once again!
rows.quest:7046:completion:0: Please take this, and know that the power allotted to you now must be used for good. Continue your journey through the caverns, and with hope, you will find the remains of my uncle. Much danger awaits you, ⟦7⟧.
rows.quest:7046:completion:1: BSpeak with me again should the need arise.
rows.quest:7064:obj:0: Slay Princess ⟦E4⟧ and return to Selendra near Shadowprey Village in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:7064:details:0: Deep in Maraudon lives an evil creature of chaos--Princess ⟦E4⟧ is an elemental force of earth related to the Old Gods. Ages ago, she and Zaetar, first son of Cenarius, began a relationship. The offspring of their time together became known to the people of ⟦E5⟧ as centaur. Ever-thankful creatures, the centaur killed Zaetar, and now hold Zaetar's remains. My quest here is to find those powerful enough to slay ⟦E4⟧ so we may recover Zaetar's remains before returning to Stonetalon.
rows.quest:7064:completion:0: This is most wonderful news, ⟦8⟧! Thank you!
rows.quest:7064:completion:1: BI will speak with Marandis and ask his wisdom on the topic of Zaetar's remains, but at least you have overcome the hardest of the tasks.
rows.quest:7064:completion:2: BI was told that if we were successful in our mission, I had permission to reward those who aided us. I was given these items as tokens from our people--you may choose one.
rows.quest:7065:obj:0: Slay Princess ⟦E4⟧ and return to Keeper Marandis at Nijel's Point in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:7065:details:0: In the depths of Maraudon lives a creature of chaos and evil, ⟦9⟧. Princess ⟦E4⟧ is an elemental force of earth related somehow to the Old Gods. Ages ago, she was sought out by Zaetar, first son of Cenarius. The offspring of their... relationship are the creatures known as centaur. Ever-thankful creatures, the centaur killed Zaetar, and now ⟦E4⟧ keeps his remains. My quest here is to find those powerful enough to slay ⟦E4⟧ so we may recover Zaetar's remains before returning to Stonetalon.
rows.quest:7065:completion:0: This is most wonderful news, ⟦10⟧! Thank you!
rows.quest:7065:completion:1: BAlthough it concerns me that you were not able to bring back Zaetar's remains, who am I to question the will of Cenarius' first born. Perhaps now the will of the centaur will break and their thirst for blood will lesson--we can only hope.
rows.quest:7065:completion:2: BIf successful in our mission, I was given these items to reward any who aided us. You may choose one as a token of thanks.
rows.quest:7066:obj:0: Seek out Remulos in ⟦E6⟧ and give him the Seed of Life.
rows.quest:7066:details:0: The misbegotten centaur--my sons and daughters--have need of their father.
rows.quest:7066:details:1: BLook around you--this place rings of hope and all that my father Cenarius preaches. It sprung from me! And I cannot take that away from them... not even for their crimes against me.
rows.quest:7066:details:2: BBut there is one thing I would ask of you to ease my brother's mind. Take this... it is the first seed that fell from the life my remains nourished. Tell him my spirit remains here, and that I live on. I am sure he will understand.
rows.quest:7066:completion:0: So my brother has finally found peace? I am proud to have lived to see this day. In all his arrogance and anger, I truly thought he was lost to us, but this... this symbol of his sacrifice only proves that he is not lost--he has only been reborn. He takes his place in nature as was his duty.
rows.quest:7066:completion:1: BThank you, ⟦11⟧. By bringing this to me, you have secured a small amount of hope that I thought I had once lost. This seed will be important to the people of this war-torn land some day... I can sense it.
rows.quest:7067:obj:0: Read the Pariah's Instructions. Afterwards, obtain the Amulet of Union from Maraudon and return it to the Centaur Pariah in southern ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:7067:details:0: Though exiled as a heretic, my beliefs still ring true--that alone drives me onward. But for my destiny to be complete, I need the aid of an outsider... one not of any centaur tribe.
rows.quest:7067:details:1: BThe task requires someone to enter the holy halls of Maraudon--a tomb my people protect, and only the most devout are ever allowed to enter.
rows.quest:7067:details:2: BIf you agree to aid me, then you need only nod. I will pass you a parchment with my instructions on it. Read it over and consider my words.
rows.quest:7067:completion:0: This is it, ⟦12⟧! This is it! Now I can begin the great task of uniting the tribes. Thank you.
rows.quest:7067:completion:1: BTake this for your efforts, please. I hope when next we meet, it will be on much different terms.
rows.quest:7068:obj:0: Collect 10 Shadowshard Fragments from Maraudon and return them to Uthel'nay in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:7068:details:0: Strong magics be found in the centaur holy place... the holy place of Maraudon. The ⟦E1⟧ tribes of centaur protect that place wit' their lives, but they canna stop us from takin' what we need.
rows.quest:7068:details:1: BYou, you head to this Maraudon place and find the rock creatures made of shadowshard. You bring me the purple crystals, and Uthel'nay make you somethin' for your time.
rows.quest:7068:details:2: BThe place be dangerous, so maybe you be bringing some friends.
rows.quest:7068:completion:0: Ah, these be perfect for me magics. Here, you take one of these trinkets and be on your way... me got much studyin' to do.
rows.quest:7070:obj:0: Collect 10 Shadowshard Fragments from Maraudon and return them to Archmage Tervosh in ⟦E8⟧ on the coast of ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:7070:details:0: I've recently begun testing various crystals and their arcane properties. Lady Proudmoore has given me leave to ask travelers heading into ⟦E1⟧ to seek out a place called Maraudon. Within the ruined temple are great elementals composed of purplish stones I've named shadowshards.
rows.quest:7070:details:1: BIf you decide to head that direction and find some of the crystals, I would be very thankful. I could even fashion you a trinket from them if you so desired.
rows.quest:7070:completion:0: These are perfect, ⟦13⟧. I actually had other adventurers return from there also and from them I was able to fashion these... please, feel free to take one for your hard work. And thank you again for more samples to study.
